title: PHC removes petitions against KP emergency and governor's rule from cause list
detail: Complying with the FCC's orders, the Peshawar High Court's administrative committee directed that no writ petitions filed on or after Oct 12 be fixed for hearing. All petitions challenging emergency and governor's rule and MPO arrests were struck from the cause list, including those seeking the recovery of CM Sohail Afridi, Speaker Babar Saleem Swati and PTI provincial president Junaid Akbar. Petitions are returned to petitioners to approach the appropriate forum, ending the Nov 10 hearing previously scheduled.
